facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.justification: MOC-2012-0017 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 4 February 2012 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including NM-2005-0006 and NM-2021-0013. The change request record covers 1 clause across 3 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2009-003, PRO-MEC-055 and STD-LFT-003.
